model.limitations: Native locks/RPC/display/backlight/OS scheduling are mocked; no LCD timing, cold boot or live idle guarantee.

host.assertions: Tap hold/gap boundaries, Euclidean distance, consumed pairs, cancellation, monotonic wrap and drawer motion-qualified releases.

sleep_observability.original_native_value: 0=screen off after successful brightness zero; 1=screen on after successful brightness restore.
sleep_observability.local_context_state: screen_off+144: 0=awake, 1=observed off, 2=waiting for the first physical wake contact release, excluded only from double tap.
sleep_observability.wake_contact: Tap state+142 remembers physical DOWN, including contacts swallowed by animation; corresponding UP clears the tap barrier. The first contact cannot qualify for double tap; drawer swipes remain active and may dismiss the custom page.
sleep_observability.read_order: The GUI proxy invokes the stock TIMER first, then samples the screen word. A previously observed off state is latched across on/physical-touch ordering.
sleep_observability.limits: An off-on interval wholly between GUI polls is not observable. GUI callback operation during screen off and real first visible wake frame remain unverified. This is not an original JS lock-screen hook.

historical_inputs: Historical analysis sources, outputs and frozen sets were not modified or regenerated.
release_boundary: These checks validate ARM/UI logic only. The added network container requires its separate offline ownership review and installer verification before hardware use.
